# AiDealDeck

> AiDealDeck sells do-it-yourself AI toolkits, called cards, for real estate pros. Each card is a spreadsheet, a playbook and a copy-and-paste prompt. The buyer pastes the prompt into Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) and Claude helps them set the tool up, with the option of a live dashboard built inside Claude.

AiDealDeck is a brand of The Showing Partner LLC (Wisconsin, USA). It is independent and is not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

## Products

- [The AI Agent Deck](https://aidealdeck.com/): all five cards plus two bonus cards. Launch price $49 through November 30, 2026; regular price $199 from December 1, 2026.
- [Real Estate KPI Tracker](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/kpi-tracker/): A KPI tracker for real estate pros. It shows how many leads turn into closings at each step, and the one number to hit each week. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Listing Exposure Playbook](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/listing-exposure-playbook/): A 14-day listing launch plan for real estate pros, with fill-in templates and seller reports on day 7 and day 14. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Lead-for-Life System](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/lead-for-life-system/): A lead follow-up system for real estate pros: call fast, follow a set plan until they book, and track how fast you call. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Commission & GCI Ledger](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/commission-gci-ledger/): A commission and GCI tracker for real estate pros: every closing, fee and split in one place, so you can see what you really kept. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [VA Playbook & Scorecard](https://aidealdeck.com/cards/va-playbook-scorecard/): A playbook for your real estate assistant: three clear jobs, a daily routine, a report each night and a score each week. Launch price $19 through November 30, 2026; regular price $49.
- [Free cards: Listing Watchdog and Morning Brief](https://aidealdeck.com/free/): free download. Listing Watchdog tells an agent when a past client or lead they are watching lists with another agent. Morning Brief is one short summary from Claude each morning.
- [Live demo](https://aidealdeck.com/demo/): a playable sample of the KPI dashboard, with sample data.

## What buyers need

- The Claude desktop app and a paid Claude plan (sold separately by Anthropic; heavier use may need a higher plan)
- Google Sheets or Excel
- A CRM is optional

## Facts

- What is AiDealDeck? AiDealDeck sells do-it-yourself AI toolkits for real estate pros. We call each toolkit a card. A card is a workbook, a short guide and one copy-and-paste prompt. You paste the prompt into Claude and Claude helps you set that tool up.
- What is a card? One tool for one part of your business: your numbers, your listings, your new leads, your money or your assistant. Each card comes with a blank workbook, a sample workbook, a START HERE guide, the setup prompt and a Setup Pack that Claude reads.
- Are these real, physical cards? Does anything get mailed to me? No. The cards are digital. Nothing is printed and nothing is mailed. We call them cards because each one is one tool. You get a download link by email right after checkout, and the files open on your computer.
- What is The AI Agent Deck? All five cards in one download, plus two bonus cards (Listing Watchdog and Morning Brief). It costs less than three single cards.
- Who is it for? Real estate pros who want their back office organized: anyone running leads, deals and commissions in a real estate sales business without hiring a developer or learning new software.
- What does it really do, step by step? 1. You buy a card. The download link is emailed to you. 2. You open Claude on your computer and paste in the card's prompt. 3. Claude asks you a few simple questions about your business. 4. Claude helps you build the tool: a tracker, a plan or a dashboard that is yours to keep. 5. You use it every week, and you can ask Claude to update it any time. Each card does one job: your numbers, your listings, your leads, your money or your assistant.
- Is it done for me? No, not yet. Today it is a do-it-yourself toolkit. Claude helps you set it up, but you do the setup and you keep it running. A done-for-me service, called the Jokers, is coming soon. Join the waitlist at aidealdeck.com/waitlist and we will tell you when it opens.
- Can I see the cards I have collected? Yes. Go to aidealdeck.com/my-deck and type the email you used with us. We email you a private link. It shows the cards you have, the ones you do not have yet, and what is coming soon. There is no password and no account to set up.
- What is the waitlist? It is how you hear first about what is coming: new cards, new decks and the Jokers, our done-for-me service where real people set up AI in your business for you. Go to aidealdeck.com/waitlist, type your first name and email, and tick what you want to hear about. It is free. We also email you our 2 free cards the same day. People on the waitlist hear first and get a small discount when each new thing opens. There are no dates or prices yet. You can unsubscribe any time.
- Is this made by Anthropic or Claude? No. AiDealDeck is an independent product built to work with Claude. It is not made or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC.
- Who is behind AiDealDeck? AiDealDeck is a brand of The Showing Partner LLC, a Wisconsin company. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any brokerage, MLS or trade association.
- How much does it cost? Through November 30: The AI Agent Deck is $49 and each single card is $19. From December 1 the regular prices are $199 for the Deck and $49 for a single card. The price on the page when you buy is the price you pay. Sales tax is added at checkout where it applies.
- Are there reviews from real estate pros? We are new (launched November 2026), so reviews are just coming in. Buyers can leave one on the feedback page, and the ones who say yes are shown on the homepage with their first name and job title. Until then, judge the work for free: the live demo and the two free cards.
- Is it a subscription? No. You pay once and keep the files. The only ongoing cost is your own Claude plan, paid to Anthropic.
- Should I buy one card or the Deck? Five single cards cost more than the Deck, and the Deck adds both bonus cards. If you want more than two cards, the Deck costs less.
- I bought a single card. Can I upgrade to the Deck? The Deck is a separate purchase. At checkout, anyone with a single card in the cart is offered the full Deck in its place. If you already bought and want to move up, email support@aidealdeck.com.
- How do I buy? Use any buy button on this site. Checkout is handled by Gumroad. We never take payment by phone.
- How do I get my files? The download link is emailed to you right after checkout, and it is on your Gumroad receipt page.
- My download link or file is not working. What do I do? We are sorry about that. Email support@aidealdeck.com with the email address you used at checkout and what happened, or call (414) 946-6479. We will fix it or send a working copy.
- I did not get my download email. What do I do? Sorry about that. Check your spam folder for an email from Gumroad. If it is not there, email support@aidealdeck.com with the email address you used at checkout and we will send it again.
- Is sales tax added? Gumroad adds sales tax at checkout where it applies.
- Can my whole team use one purchase? Yes. One purchase covers one buyer: you and the people on your own team. No separate team license is needed. It does not cover a whole company, brokerage or office; each other team needs its own purchase.
- Can I share, copy or resell the files? No. One purchase is for one buyer and that buyer's own team. You may not sell, share, post or pass the files or prompts to anyone outside your team, even for free. Every file carries a license line. See the Terms.
- What do I need to use a card? The Claude desktop app and a paid Claude plan, both from Anthropic, plus Google Sheets or Excel. A CRM is optional.
- Do I need a paid Claude plan? Yes. The cards use Claude features that need a paid plan. Claude Pro is currently $20 a month and is sold separately by Anthropic. It is not included in our price.
- Will I need a bigger Claude plan later? Maybe. The more cards you run and the more often they update, the more of your Claude plan they use. Heavier use may need a higher plan. Anthropic sets those plans and prices and can change them.
- Does it work with ChatGPT or another AI? The cards are written and tested for Claude. We do not support other AI tools.
- Does it work on a phone or tablet? Setup needs the Claude desktop app on a computer. After that you can open your workbook anywhere Google Sheets or Excel runs.
- Do I need Google Sheets, or can I use Excel? Either one. A free Google account is recommended so your trackers can update on their own, and Excel works too.
- Will it work with my CRM? If Claude has a connector for your CRM, Claude can read it directly. If not, you can export a spreadsheet from your CRM. We cannot promise every CRM works, so check before you buy.
- Do I need to know how to code? No. You paste one prompt and answer plain questions.
- Does it work with Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Lofty or BoomTown? We cannot promise any one CRM. If Claude has a connector for your CRM, Claude can read it directly. If not, export a spreadsheet from your CRM (Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Lofty, BoomTown, Sierra, LionDesk and most others can export one) and Claude works from that. Every card comes with its own workbook, so nothing depends on a connector. Check before you buy.
- What does it cost per month, all in? Our cards are a one-time purchase; there is no subscription from us. The ongoing cost is your Claude plan, paid to Anthropic: Claude Pro is currently $20 a month, and heavier use may need a higher plan. Google Sheets is free, and Excel is whatever you already pay for it.
- How long does setup take? It is different for everyone. Claude walks you through it one step at a time. The Lead-for-Life System takes the longest because you build your follow-up plan in your CRM and write your own emails.
- How do I set up a card? Save the download to your Downloads folder. Open the Claude desktop app, start a new chat and add that folder. Paste in the COPY THIS PROMPT file and press Enter. Claude asks you simple questions and you approve what it sets up. The START HERE guide in every download walks through it.
- Do I get a spreadsheet or a dashboard? Both are in the box and you choose. Every card has a workbook. During setup Claude asks whether you want a live dashboard as your main view. If you say yes, Claude builds it for you inside Claude from your own numbers, and the workbook stays as the place your data lives.
- Will my dashboard look like the one on the site? The site shows examples with sample data. Claude builds your dashboard from your own numbers, so yours may look different.
- Can I see a dashboard before I buy? Yes. There is a live demo of the KPI dashboard with sample data that you can play with.
- What if I get stuck during setup? Reply to your receipt email, email support@aidealdeck.com or call (414) 946-6479. We can help you with the steps. We cannot log in to your accounts.
- Can I set up one card now and the others later? Yes. Each card stands on its own. Play them in any order.
- Do I have to keep it updated? Yes. A tracker only helps if your numbers go into it. Where Claude can read your CRM or your sheet, it can update for you on the schedule you set.
- What does the Real Estate KPI Tracker do? It tracks lead to appointment set, held, signed, under contract and closed, with the real percentage at each step. It works out the weekly number you need for the goal you type in, and shows which lead sources produce closings. More about this card.
- What does the KPI Tracker do that my CRM dashboard does not? Most CRM dashboards show activity: calls, emails, tasks. The KPI Tracker shows conversion. It counts lead, appointment set, appointment held, signed, under contract and closed, with the real percentage at each step, works out the one weekly number to hit for the goal you type in, and shows which lead sources turn into closings. If Claude can read your CRM or a spreadsheet export from it, the numbers come across without retyping.
- What does the Listing Exposure Playbook do? It gives every listing the same 14-day launch plan, with fill-in templates and day-7 and day-14 seller reports. More about this card.
- What does the Lead-for-Life System do? It lays out a follow-up plan for every new lead until they book, keeps a daily call list, scores how fast leads get a first contact, and includes a TCPA checklist. More about this card.
- What does the Commission & GCI Ledger do? It records every closing with its commission, fees, referral fees and splits, and keeps team totals separate from your own income. It is a tracking tool, not accounting software. More about this card.
- What does the VA Playbook & Scorecard do? It gives your assistant a narrow role with three jobs, a daily routine, an end-of-day report and a weekly scorecard. More about this card.
- What is the Listing Watchdog? A bonus card. You tell it which people to watch: past clients, people who went quiet after an appointment, referrals. It tells you when one of them lists with another agent, or when that listing expires or comes back. Public listing sites can be late or wrong, so always confirm on your MLS.
- Can I use the Listing Watchdog to win back a seller who listed with someone else? No. Do not contact a seller while they are listed with another agent. That can break your MLS and association rules. The Watchdog is for learning. It shows who went quiet and who you lost, so you can fix that step in your sales process and lose fewer listings. If a listing ends and the seller is free again, follow your own rules for expired listings. Always check your own rules first.
- What is the Morning Brief? A bonus card. It is one short summary from Claude each morning of what is due, who needs a call and what slipped. It reads every card you have set up.
- Are the bonus cards really free? Yes. The Listing Watchdog and Morning Brief are a free download. They are also included in the Deck. They still need the Claude desktop app and a paid Claude plan.
- Will there be more cards? We plan to release more. New cards are separate products, sold separately, and no release dates are promised.
- Will it text, call or email my leads for me? No. It drafts messages for you to review and send. It never texts, calls or emails anyone on its own. If you set up your own automation, you are responsible for consent and for TCPA, CAN-SPAM, do-not-call and your state's rules.
- Will it get me more leads, listings or closings? We do not promise more leads, listings, closings or income. It shows you your numbers and what needs your attention. Results depend on your own work.
- Is it legal, tax or brokerage advice? No. The cards are tools, not professional advice. You are responsible for your license law, brokerage policies, MLS rules and fair housing laws.
- Can AI make mistakes in my numbers? Yes. AI can make mistakes. Check what Claude sets up, fills in or drafts, and check important numbers before you rely on them.
- Do you reward referrals? Yes, both ways. When someone you referred buys a card or the Deck and names you at checkout, you get one free single card of your choice. They get one too, because they bought with a referral. A purchase is required: free downloads do not count.
- When does the person who referred me get their free card? Right after your purchase, if you typed their referral code: we email it to them automatically. If you typed only a name, they may need to email support@aidealdeck.com to claim it.
- How do I say who referred me? At checkout there is a box that asks "How did you hear about us?" Type their referral code. No code? Type their name. If you have a creator code, type that instead.
- Where is my referral code? We email it to you right after your first purchase. It starts with REF. Give it to another real estate pro. When they buy and type it in the "How did you hear about us?" box at checkout, you each get one free card, and we email yours automatically.
- What is a creator code? Some creators who talk about AiDealDeck share a code. When you buy at least one card and enter that code in the "How did you hear about us?" box at checkout, you get one free single card of your choice.
- Do I get a free card every time I buy? No. A free card only comes with a creator code or a referral, and only when you buy at least one card. A purchase with no code and no referral does not include a free card.
- Do I have to buy something to use a creator code or a referral? Yes. The free card comes with a purchase. You need to buy at least one card (or the Deck) and enter the code or the name at checkout. A code on its own, or with only the free bonus cards, does not qualify.
- I used a creator code and did not get a free card. Why? The most common reason is that no card was purchased: the free card is only valid when you buy at least one other card. If you did buy and entered the code at checkout, email support@aidealdeck.com with the email you used and the code, and we will send your free card.
- How do I get my free card? We email you within minutes of your purchase. Click the card you want in that email and the price is already $0. The link works once, for one card, and does not expire.
- I forgot to enter the code or the name at checkout. Can I still get it? Email support@aidealdeck.com with the email you used at checkout and the code or the name. If the purchase qualifies we will add it.
- I bought the Deck with a creator code or a referral. What do I get? The Deck already includes all five cards, so you choose one of two things. Either one future card of your choice free when new cards come out, with no expiration, or 10% off your Deck. If you entered the code in the "How did you hear about us?" box we record the free future card for you and confirm it by email. If you would rather have the 10% off, reply to that email.
- Does my free future card expire? No. If you bought the Deck with a creator code or a referral and chose the free future card, it stays on your account until you use it.
- Can I combine codes or get more than one free card from one order? No. One code or one referral per order, and one free card per qualifying order.
- I am a creator. How do I get a code? Email support@aidealdeck.com. Creators get their own link and code and earn 30% of each sale made through their link. Creators must tell their audience that they are paid.
- Why does checkout say Gumroad? Gumroad is the company that runs our checkout, payment and file delivery. It is the merchant of record for your purchase.
- Is checkout secure? Payment is handled by Gumroad. We never receive your full card number.
- Why do I have to accept the Terms? Because the files are delivered instantly and all sales are final, we ask you to confirm you have read the Terms before you pay.
- At checkout I was offered the Deck in place of my card. What is that? If you have a single card in your cart, checkout offers the full Deck instead. Saying yes replaces the card in your cart with the Deck at the Deck price. Saying no keeps your single card.
- I took the free cards and was offered the KPI Tracker. Do I have to buy it? No. It is an optional offer. Your free cards are still free.
- Can I buy it as a gift? Yes. Checkout has a "Give as a gift" switch. Enter the other person's email and the download goes to them. You pay, and the license belongs to their business. You cannot pass on a copy you bought for yourself.
- Can I get a receipt or an invoice? Your receipt is emailed right after checkout, and it has a link to generate an invoice.
- I think I was charged twice or charged the wrong price. What do I do? Email support@aidealdeck.com with the email you used at checkout, what you were charged and when. We will look into it and reply.
- I typed the wrong email at checkout. How do I get my files? Email support@aidealdeck.com from the address you want to use, with the name on the order and the date. We will get the download to you.
- I just bought. What do I do next? Watch the 1-minute video at aidealdeck.com/start. Open the email from AiDealDeck, click View content and Download, open the Claude desktop app, click + and add your Downloads folder, then paste in the COPY THIS PROMPT file and press Enter.
- How do I get 10% off my next purchase? After you buy, answer a few quick questions at aidealdeck.com/feedback. Your 10% code shows on the page when you send your answers. Type it in the Discount code box at checkout. It works for people who have already bought a card or the Deck.
- Can I get a refund? All sales are final because the files are delivered instantly and you keep them, except where the law where you live gives you a right that cannot be waived. Please read this page and the Terms before you buy. If a file is missing or will not open, we fix it.
- A file will not open or is missing. What do I do? Email support@aidealdeck.com with the email you used at checkout and what happened. We will help or send a working copy.
- How do I reach a person? Email support@aidealdeck.com, or call (414) 946-6479 any time. Sarah answers around the clock, can answer most questions and passes messages to the team.
- Is the phone line a real person? The line is answered around the clock by Sarah, an AI assistant. For anything she cannot answer she takes your name and email and the team replies.
- Can a card take over my computer, hack me or leak my private information? No. A card is a set of files: guides, spreadsheets and words you paste into Claude. Nothing from us installs on your computer, and nothing runs by itself. Claude only sees the folders and accounts you choose to add, and you can stop it at any time. We never get access to your computer, your accounts or your files. Claude is made by Anthropic, a separate company. AI can make mistakes, so check what it sets up, and do not add a folder you would not want it to read.
- Can you see my leads, clients or numbers? No. The cards run in your own accounts: your Claude account, your Google or Excel files and your CRM. We have no access to them and never see what you put in.
- Where is my data stored? In your own accounts. Your workbook lives in your Google Drive or on your computer, and your dashboard lives in your Claude account.
- What do you collect about me? Your name, email and order details from Gumroad when you buy or download, anything you email or tell us on a call, and visit statistics from this site. The Privacy page has the details and your choices.
- Will you email me? You get your receipt and download link. If you bought or subscribed, we may send product help and news about new cards. Every such email has an unsubscribe link.
